versions.description_html:
Learn what makes a Copilot+ PC different from ordinary AI laptops. Discover the 40 TOPS NPU requirement, privacy safeguards, and who actually benefits.

One number decides whether your next laptop gets the AI features, and it's forty. Every new Windows laptop claims to be an AI PC, but only a special few earn the Copilot+ badge.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Makes a PC a Copilot+ PC
  • The Chip Most People Have Never Heard Of
  • What Runs Right on Your Laptop
  • Where Your Data Actually Goes
  • Copilot+ PC vs an Ordinary AI PC
  • Who Actually Benefits, and Who Can Wait
  • The Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot: What Actually Makes People More Productive with Adrian Espes [MVP]
  • Beyond Copilot: Building Enterprise AI Agents That Actually Work with Copilot Studio with Manpreet Singh [MVP-MCT]
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of AI & Copilot: the most-listened episodes
